summary: A short note from Alex McKenzie at BBN that attaches network traffic statistics for the ARPANET for August 1972. The tables show how many packets each host sent over the period. It updates RFC 378. BBN had been giving these figures to ARPA each month and now shared them with the whole network community.

eli5.summary: This is a monthly tally from the early internet, showing how many packets each computer sent. Think of counting how many letters each house mailed in a month, so the post office can see where the traffic is.

questions: how much traffic did each arpanet host send
